newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB asks Canada to up 1996/97 wheat, barley price.
newsitem.headline: CWB asks Canada to up 1996/97 wheat, barley price.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board said Thursday it recommended the Canadian government approve increases of C$14 to C$45 a tonne in 1996/97 (Aug/July) wheat, durum and barley initial prices in its June Estimated Pool Return (EPR) outlook for the current crop year.

Initial prices are government backed price guarantees while the CWB's EPRs are estimates of final returns to farmers based on sales the CWB has made or expects to make by the end of the price pooling period.
Durum prices were buoyed by tight world supply and recent dry conditions in North Dakota and parts of the Prairies.
